question.problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ -2 & -8 \\ -9 & 7\end{aligned}],\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-3x+y \\ ax-8y \\ -9x+by\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14136609/assets/8d99b24562293e815ac8aafaef8c4b0279fd8056c9b1c55702b636f96a458a46.svg)
Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $\mathbf{T}:\mathbb{R}^2 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ shown above. What is the value of $a-b?$
current_example.worked_solution:
Given the vector ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14136609/assets/bc0cd06154abb5b22c0242fff363ed688edb52acb1d271c4122545fbbb80d5dd.svg) we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-8 & -5 \\ -3 & -6 \\ -4 & 5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-8x-5y \\ -3x-6y \\ -4x+5y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-5y-8x \\ -3x-6y \\ 5y-4x\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $\mathbf{T}$ is given by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14136609/assets/8522ebd731d7e4c78c428a40340bf59666215b2f94f786abcd6aa45a5923c3b1.svg)

Finally, $a-b=(-5)-(-4)=-1.$
